note: Boxes [W, S, E, N] where export_world_pack.py --island-regions waives the isolation gate: every islet of 0.3 km2 or more expands here (never onto bigger land). Atoll country only; high-island groups (Fiji, Vanuatu, the Solomons, Hawaii, the Caribbean) are left to the isolation rule.
